summary: Google DeepMind's Josh Woodward announced live launches of Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite in the Gemini app, citing reduced token usage and higher output speed.

mechanisms.reason: The post states a specific reduction in tokens needed per coding task, meaning less compute work per unit of output.
mechanisms.quote: 3.6 Flash cuts token usage by up to 65% on complex coding

practices.reason: Two updated Gemini variants ship today with stated improvements in token efficiency on coding tasks and output speed, giving engineers concrete reasons to swap models for cost- or latency-sensitive workloads.
practices.quote: 3.5 Flash-Lite reaches speeds of 350 output tokens/sec
